# Chart.js (vendored)

- **Library:** Chart.js
- **Version:** 4.4.3
- **Vendored file:** `chart.umd.min.js`
- **Source URL:** `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.3/dist/chart.umd.min.js`
- **License:** MIT

This file is vendored locally so site pages can load Chart.js from `self` and satisfy a strict Content-Security-Policy (`script-src 'self'`) without allowing `cdn.jsdelivr.net`.
